attchmntText: Appointment of Mr. Krishna Mohan Shukla as a Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company w.e.f November 02, 2026.
Patel Integrated Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

Patel Integrated Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 02, 2026, titled "Press release/Media Release on the Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter & half year ended 30th September 2026.".
Submission of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, along with Limited Review Report.

Company wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, i.e. Monday, November 02, 2026, has, inter alia, approved the following matters: 1. Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter & half year ended on 30t September, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors thereon. 2. Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter & half year ended on 30th September, 2026 along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors thereon. 3. Based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board has approved the appointment of Mr. Krishna Mohan Shukla as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company with effect from November 02, 2026
